newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Both chambers of parliament met on Tuesday to negotiate the composition of standing commissions.

* The outgoing government of Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu is discussing winter energy stocks at its weekly meeting and a draft agreement with Russia to extend pipeline capacity to transport natural gas to Romania and other Balkan countries. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
